title: Three-span beam with fixed ends and two point loads

source.work: McGuire, W., Gallagher, R. H., Ziemian, R. D., Matrix Structural Analysis
source.notes: input data and targets read on the cited pages; nothing of the source is reproduced

analysis: Plane (x-y) problem of the source modelled in 3D with the global Y axis vertical, so that the source's x, y and theta_z are the model's X, Y and rz. In-plane bending is about local z for every member (default orientation), hence the source's I is the section's Iz. Beam of 15 m in three 5 m spans: a (0) and d (15 m) fixed, b (5 m) and c (10 m) on simple supports; I = 50e6 mm^4, E = 200,000 MPa. Loads: 20 kN downward at x = 2 m and at x = 7 m. A node o is placed at midlength (7.5 m), where the source reports the deflection. The full beam is analysed (the source combines a symmetric and an antisymmetric half-model). First order, no shear deformation. Section properties the source does not give because they do not enter its plane model (Iy, J; A where stated) are placeholders that do not influence the targets.
